setupGuide.title: Set up your JVZoo API credentials
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need a JVZoo account and access to create or view an API Application. JVZoo API v2.0 uses HTTP Basic auth: enter your JVZoo API key as the username and enter x as the password.

steps.title: Open the JVZoo API Applications page
steps.description: Sign in to JVZoo and open the Applications area under My Account.

steps.title: Create a new API Application if you do not already have one
steps.description: Use the Applications page to create an API Application for MindCloud. The JVZoo docs state that you create a new API Application under the My Account tab.

steps.title: Copy the API key for the active application
steps.description: From Vendor Applications, copy the API key shown for the active application. Keep it secret because the JVZoo docs state that the key grants full access to your account.

steps.title: Enter the JVZoo credentials in MindCloud
steps.description: In the MindCloud connection form, paste the JVZoo API key into the username field and enter x as the password.
